text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the National University of Singapore (Initial Appointments and Other Transitional Provisions) Rules.

heading.en: Faculty of Accountancy and Business Administration

text.en: 2. The School of Accountancy and Business Administration of the University of Singapore shall on and after 8th August 1980 become a faculty of the University to be known as the Faculty of Accountancy and Business Administration.

3. All student societies of the University of Singapore registered under the Societies Act [Cap. 311] which have been formed with the approval of the University of Singapore shall be deemed to have been formed with the approval of the University.
